It encodes the round 2 builder policy: claude-opus-5-5 on non-UI work and openai/gpt-6.1-sol on UI-surface work. It also checks that the opposite value is rejected and that a silent runtime leaves executed_model null.

I re-ran tests.test_model_migration_verification and tests.test_readme_showcase: 28 tests OK, 3 skipped. The readme showcase link test passes now that the runs/ tree is back.

Evidence agrees with the test policy: the builder envelope shows configured_model openai/gpt-6.1-sol and executed_model gpt-6.1-sol (the Codex bare-name self-report of the same model). Limitation: the tests use a fake command runtime, so they cover wiring and recording, not live execution. Whether reviewer-design and reviewer-ux (S3) executed on Codex is outside this station. reviewer-ux needs a successful re-fire, because the on-disk round 2 attempt failed on an empty Codex output.
